rows.en: Take this!
Allow me to end this here.
This one settles it!
Sorry, but I'm taking you down.
I'll finish it right here.
I won't let my guard down until the end.
Looks like you underestimated me.
I'll keep going at this pace.
You lacked the experience to take me on.
I'll take the biggest prey myself!
That seems to be our target.
Leave that one to me.
Target shot down, confirmed.
I have to handle at least this much.
Looks like I haven't lost my touch.
The shield's gone.
I won't back down over a mere shield!
I never expected the shield to be destroyed.
I only fight battles I can win.
rows.notes: Transcript 'shousan' (praise); read as 'shousan' = chance of winning.

rows.en: Still moving fine.
That won't bring me down.
The enemy is quite good, too.
I can't whine over this much.
We need a move to break this situation.
This is where it gets serious.
It's a bit early to give up.
I haven't felt this tension in a while.
I never thought I'd be driven this far.
I must decide my own path.
rows.notes: Transcript 'yuku sei' garbled; guessed 'yukusue' (fate) / 'hikigiwa' (when to retreat).

rows.en: There's still a chance! I can't give up!
Looks like this is as far as I go.
I suppose I can't fight like I did in my youth.
I never imagined it would end like this.
Be careful.
Calm down!
Assess the situation calmly.
Eject at once!
If you get shot down--
I won't let your efforts go to waste.
Thanks for the backup.
Don't let this attack chance slip!
Reinforcements now. Let's see how the battle changes.
The sacrifices were far too many.
If only I'd had more strength.
I can't let the situation get any worse.
I thank you all for your work.
I can't lose to the young ones yet! Ha ha ha!
The operation looks like a success. All forces, return!
Out of time... I'm getting old.
What a thing... out of time.
Out of time! All forces, withdraw at once!
You all did well. This is all my responsibility.
I never thought failure awaited us.
I've lost my edge.
rows.notes: Transcript 'iyake ga mawatta' read as idiom 'yaki ga mawatta' (lost one's edge).

rows.en: Switch to cover fire!
You'll take rear support.
Fire!
You'll take the front line.
Charge!
Move up and put pressure on the enemy!
Fall back and size up the battle.
Fall back! There's no need to rush to your death!
You're too far forward!
Those who take pride in their own wings, advance with me!
Let's see your trump card.
Show your strength!
Let's go, you lot!
Don't underestimate me.
I'll get a little serious!
Understood!
rows.notes: Transcript 'hokorareta' (was praised); probably 'makasareta' / acknowledgement, matching the 178-180 group.

rows.en: Understood.
I need you to pull a bit more weight, Captain.
The Captain's in danger at this rate.
rows.notes: Transcript 'taichou' written with kanji for 'physical condition'; read as 'captain'.

rows.en: I've been asking too much of the Captain.
Pass the Captain's command to me!
So the Captain's been shot down.
No time to grieve. We'll fight on for the Captain, too.
A song... It takes me back to my youth.
Fighting in the face of this song is rather crude.
